paper_title: Shifting Long-Context LLMs Research from Input to Output
caption: Proportion of real-user demand: The aforementioned 2K range refers to the interval [2K, 4K), and similarly for the other ranges. Solid color fill for input demand, slash fill for output demand in the Wildchat dataset.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the proportion of real-user demand across four input/output ranges for long-context LLMs. The horizontal axis represents the input/output ranges, displayed in numerical order from left to right as 2K-Input, 2K-Output, 4K-Input, 4K-Output, 8K-Input, 8K-Output, 16K-Input, and 16K-Output. The vertical axis, labeled “Number,” ranges from 0 to 120,000, with a linear scale and tick intervals of 4,000. The tallest bar, colored orange, represents the 8K-Output range, with a value of approximately 108,494. The second tallest bar, also orange, depicts the 4K-Output range and a value of 78,188. The next tallest, colored brown, displays the 8K-Input range with a value of 17,865.  The shortest bar, colored gold, corresponds to the 16K-Output range with a value of 832, while the bar colored tan represents the 2K-Output range showing 3,784.  The bar colored teal represents the 8K-Input range with 1,401 value and the bar colored blue represents the 16K-Input range having a value of 4,247. Each bar represents a breakdown of demand based on the corresponding input and output range for long-context LLMs.
